items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-04
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think Andy Anderson was talking about that. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, that's him.

ctx.x: They would often come down there with me, out to La Vida. Well, I think John, uh, Lee Collins and John Marrero left for, uh, left, uh, a tenor player there. Yeah, they went to Chicago and left him there. And they went to Chicago and left him there. And David Jones stayed there with me a long time. As a matter of fact, he opened up, uh, a teacher school uptown here somewhere. here some way. Alfred Williams stayed there a long time. Jim Robinson stayed there a long time. But uh, Alfred left and went to Texas. And…
Is that the sort of Mexican looking fella? Yeah, yeah, that's him. I think Andy Anderson was talking about that.
